title: Is it ready for prime time? Elemental Dispatch
author: BunD___
selftext:
Been messing around the last 8 weeks or so mashing up two of my favorite games I played earlier this year: Dispatch and Slay the Spire 2

I really enjoyed Dispatch's gameplay mechanic and wanted to try and see if there was a way to build off of it. Needless to say, I got carried away and continued adding more and more features.

Let me know what you all think of the gameplay loop, difficulty, UI, art, sound, if anything feels off etc.

Play here:

[elementaldispatch.com](http://elementaldispatch.com)

* Fable - code
* ChatGPT - Art references/style/design
* Ludo - Art animations (really expensive :(, but the output was nice when right)
* Suno - music
